{{Top|notoc=1}}
[[File:Scoundrels_meter.jpg|thumb|right|350px|Various criminals in front of a metric height chart]]
{{Quote|The approach will not be easy. You are required to maneuver straight down this trench and skim the surface to this point. The target area is only two meters wide. It's a small thermal exhaust port, right below the main port. The shaft leads directly to the reactor system. A precise hit will start a chain reaction which should destroy the station.|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]]|<ref name="Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
The '''meter''', known as the '''Imperial standard meter''' under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], was an established unit of measurement for length used by the [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. One meter equaled 100 [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeters]],<ref name="Death Star novel">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref> or 1000 [[Millimeter/Legends|millimeters]], and was roughly equivalent to three [[Foot/Legends|feet]].<ref name="SWK">{{Kids1997Cite|9|Who Is That Alien?|Who Is That Alien? Ugnaughts & Kowakian Monkey-Lizards}}</ref> Despite being named after the Galactic Empire, the meter was also used during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] reign as well.<ref name="MF">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref>

After scouring the [[Death Star plans/Legends|plans]] for the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] discovered that a small, exposed, [[Thermal exhaust port/Legends|thermal exhaust port]] led directly to the massive battle station's [[Reactor/Legends|reactor core]]. The small exhaust port was only two meters wide, meaning a small [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] would be able to attack the vulnerable exhaust port. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] expressed that this mission was not impossible, explaining the he used to bulls-eye [[Womp rat/Legends|womp rats]] in his [[T-16 skyhopper/Legends|T-16]] back home, which were not much bigger than two meters. Skywalker eventually succeeded in firing a [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] into the exhaust port and destroying the battle station during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope" />
